artist.name: Holly Humberstone
artist.short_description: Holly Humberstone is an Afterglow discovery artist in the broader emotional-pop and songwriter catalogue.
artist.biography: Holly Humberstone is an English singer-songwriter known for personal lyric writing set against layered, sometimes shadowy indie-pop arrangements. Her early EP Falling Asleep at the Wheel appeared in 2020 and introduced songs including 'Deep End' and the title track. The Walls Are Way Too Thin followed in 2021, and her first album Paint My Bedroom Black arrived in 2023. Later material includes work in progress and 2026's Cruel World. Interviews about the early EP are particularly useful for Afterglow because Humberstone spoke about learning how to communicate through music; she described 'Deep End' as an expression of care for her sister during a difficult period. She also identified 'Falling Asleep at the Wheel' as a milestone in finding her own musical identity. Across eras, her writing can feel both physically rooted in places and emotionally internal. The selected catalogue therefore offers an indie-pop counterpart to Gracie Abrams and Lizzy McAlpine. Afterglow should distinguish a directly documented family story from broader editorial interpretations about homesickness, change or relationships.
